_note: One entry per approval and per rule. Every pass/fail decision is made in engine.py from these entries. verified_on = checked against the public source pages (see data/guidelines/). Still to confirm in person with USG / Campus Activities (task B4).

approvals.name: USG funding application
approvals.text: USG funding requests are due Wednesday at 11:59 PM, six academic weeks before the event.

approvals.name: GSG funding application
approvals.text: GSG applications are due 6–8 weeks before your event date (varies by event type). Greenlight uses the safer 8 weeks.

approvals.name: Venue request
approvals.text: Requests should be made early enough — generally at least three to six weeks in advance. (Greenlight uses five weeks.)

approvals.name: Event permit (UEPA)
approvals.text: Once Trojan Event Services has confirmed that space is available, organizers must submit a UEPA at least three weeks prior to the event date.

approvals.name: Catering / food approval
approvals.text: All food and beverage must be supplied by an approved vendor. No "homemade" items will be approved.

approvals.name: Fundraising meeting (Campus Activities)
approvals.text: Clubs selling tickets must meet with Campus Activities at least two weeks before the event.

approvals.name: Fundraising sign-off (Bookstore & Hospitality)
approvals.text: The form must be returned with all required signatures (including Bookstore and/or Hospitality) at least 2 weeks before your event date.

approvals.name: Start social dance approval
approvals.text: Social dance approval must be started three months before the event.

approvals.name: Social dance approval form
approvals.text: The social dance form is due at least five weeks before the event.

rules.text: USG funds up to 4 events per semester per RSO.
rules.fix: This would be funded event #{n} this semester. Fund it another way, or move it to next semester.

rules.text: Individual organizations may receive a maximum of $8,000 from the USG Funding Department per year.
rules.fix: You'd reach ${total:,.0f} for the year. Cut the request by at least ${over:,.0f}.

rules.text: USG venue funding is capped at $4,000.
rules.fix: Venue lines total ${venue:,.0f}. Cut them by ${over:,.0f}, or pay the difference from club funds.

rules.text: All food and beverage must be supplied by an approved vendor. No "homemade" items will be approved.
rules.fix: Switch to a USC-approved vendor, or give the food away free instead of selling it.

rules.text: Once Trojan Event Services has confirmed that space is available, organizers must submit a UEPA at least three weeks prior to the event date.
rules.fix: Get the venue confirmed by Trojan Event Services first, then file the UEPA.

rules.text: USG may deny an application when the RSO is receiving funding from another University income source.
rules.fix: Say clearly in the application which costs the other source covers and which ones you're asking USG to cover.

rules.text: USG may deny an application for past instances of misuse of funds within the academic year.
rules.fix: Settle any open reimbursement issues with USG before you submit.

rules.text: Applications are reviewed on a first come first serve basis until all funds are exhausted.
rules.fix: Submit as early as you can and check USG Live Updates. Have a backup plan for funding.

deadline_passed.fix: The deadline was {deadline}. Move the event to {earliest} or later, or drop this feature.

break_crossing.text: Academic-week deadlines don't count break weeks, so the count is less certain near breaks.
break_crossing.fix: This window crosses {breaks}. Confirm the exact deadline with usgfunds@usc.edu.

event_in_break.fix: Your event falls in {name}. Most offices and venues are closed. Confirm with the office, or pick a date outside the break.

returned.fix: This was returned. Fix what the office flagged and resubmit.

depends_pending.fix: Get "{dep}" approved. This office may hold your request until it is.

_note_step: 'step' is the order an officer does things in. The USG/GSG application needs the venue confirmation (ESR), the Hospitality food form and the UEPA Event ID, so those come first.
_note_levels: Levels: reject = a rule is broken; risk = something the club can fix; warning = a risk factor the club can't change (shown, but never blocks Ready).
